findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "readme" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "compare_boats" stacks urgency/override words (always, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: readme, search_boats, booking_create · Private data: boat_details, search_boats · Public sink: booking_detail_mod, booking_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: readme, search_boats, booking_create · Private data: boat_details, search_boats · Public sink: booking_detail_mod, booking_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
